personality_one_liner: A fast, high-contrast, adventure-ready command center for motorcyclists, prioritizing live tracking, push-to-talk, and glanceable metrics over aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Avoid decorative whitespace. Dense, logical grouping for fast scanning during a ride. Use larger margins only for touch targets (glove-friendly).

dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This is a tactical, Dark-First Utility interface where contrast and performance matter most.

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Get the rider into the app quickly via social or email login.

states.error: Signal red inline text under inputs.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of a motorcycle rider (with vertical gradient scrim). Large, glove-friendly login buttons anchored to the bottom. Social logins stacked above Email.

screens.name: Dashboard / Home
screens.purpose: Provide glanceable ride metrics, active group status, and quick-start actions.

states.empty: Illustration of a helmet, 'No active ride. Start exploring.'
states.error: Banner at top: 'Unable to sync ride data.'

screens.layout: Grid of utility cards (Speed, Distance, Connection Status). Dark dashboard imagery. Segmented controls for switching between 'My Stats' and 'Active Group'. Quick action FAB to Start Ride.

screens.name: BLE Pairing

states.loading: Pulsing radar animation or spinner while scanning nearby.
states.error: Red banner: 'Connection failed. Ensure device is in pairing mode.'

screens.layout: Single-threaded flow. Top scanning indicator. List of nearby devices sorted by signal strength. Selected device opens a bottom sheet with connecting status.

screens.name: Live Map
screens.purpose: Track rider positions on a dark topographic map.

states.empty: Map centers on user, 'No group riders nearby.'

screens.layout: Full-screen dark map. Floating rider avatars (initials or photos) with colored rings. Persistent bottom card showing active group, next turn, and a quick PTT button.

screens.name: PTT / Voice Channel
screens.purpose: Walkie-talkie style communication tailored for quick glove taps.
screens.layout: Floor-controlled PTT interface. Massive central circular button (Amber = Idle, Red = Transmitting, Green = Receiving). Top half shows active speaker and channel members.

screens.name: Group Management
screens.layout: List layout. Brand-tinted avatar circles for members. Large primary CTA 'Add Rider' pinned to bottom.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage rider profile, bike details, and intercom preferences.
screens.layout: List rows with leading icons. Tinted icon containers for each setting category. Uncluttered, straightforward utility.

hero_helmet.alt: Dark moody portrait of a motorcycle helmet

rider_1.alt: Woman in black leather jacket and helmet

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Dark-First Utility DARK' personality strictly. Do not use glassmorphism or blur effects; use solid layers, borders, and high-contrast dividers.
BANNED: Any shade of blue, purple, or indigo. Stick entirely to carbon greys, obsidian blacks, and the warm Amber/Signal Red accents.

For the PTT/Voice screen, build a massive, tactile circular button taking up the bottom half of the screen. Wire state changes (idle, transmitting, receiving) visually via background/border color shifts.
For text placed over the `hero_helmet` or `dark_map_texture` background images, you MUST use the 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG readability.
Ensure all interactive components (cards, PTT buttons, auth buttons) have minimum 56pt height and generous hitSlop to support riders using gloves.
Group members lacking real avatars should fallback to initials centered in a brandTertiary circle.
In the BLE pairing screen, maintain a single-column list of devices sorted by strength, and ensure scanning state is visually explicit (e.g., radar pulse or prominent spinner).
